title: AMD takes on Nvidia with its Helios AI rack-scale system
summary: AMD is challenging its chipmaker rival with a new rack-scale system that will start shipping to customers later this year.
llm_summary: AMD is launching the Helios AI rack-scale system, a powerful computing platform designed to compete with NVIDIA's offerings in the field of artificial intelligence. This system will start shipping to customers later this year, marking a significant push by AMD into the AI market. With Helios, AMD aims to provide a high-performance alternative to NVIDIA's solutions for AI workloads.
